observations: Photo 0 shows a retail box for a Boscon Electric Kettle.
The model number BOS-EK20S is printed on multiple sides of the box.
The capacity is stated as 2.0L on the box.
Multiple identical boxes are packed inside a larger cardboard shipping carton.
The actual kettle and its power base are not visible outside of the packaging.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI AFUNKU' is present on the image.

claims.claim: Plugs into an outlet and uses electricity to power an integrated heating element
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows packaging for an electric kettle which functions this way.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item.
risks.proof: A photo of the kettle outside of the box.

risks.risk: The heating element may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the kettle boiling water.

risks.risk: The power base or cord may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo showing the kettle and its base together.

proof_requests: Photo of the kettle outside the box.
Photo of the power base and cord.
Video of the kettle plugged in and boiling water.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging. The item can be priced at its worst-case scenario (missing or non-functional) since the actual unit is not shown.
